value.rationale: The 2026 motivating work leaves the rate of prior concentration and subleading robust-thermodynamic cost open. The sharp 1/log minority mass, t log log term, and full symmetry-breaking boundary layer resolve when the leading worst-exit-rate approximation loses design information. This natural physical tuning problem is substantive even in its minimal two-state realization and is not merely the established channel formula or a normalization check.
